label: Bible Study
prompt: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is _____.
verse: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
note: The sin of omission — knowing the good and skipping it anyway.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: So let all thine enemies perish, O LORD: but let them that love him be as the _____ when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.
verse: So let all thine enemies perish, O LORD: but let them that love him be as the sun when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.
note: Deborah's song ends by wishing that all who love God would shine like the sun rising in its might.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being _____ with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
verse: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
note: Even Jesus got tired: wearied from the journey, he sat on Jacob's well and soon met a Samaritan woman.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For the LORD thy God is a _____ fire, even a jealous God.
verse: For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.
note: Moses warns against carved idols: Israel's God burns with holy jealousy over his people.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And my speech and my preaching was not with _____ words of man's wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power:
verse: And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man's wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power:
note: Paul's preaching in Corinth: no 'enticing words' of clever rhetoric, just a demonstration of the Spirit and power.
